name: Navigate the robot to a target pose
description: Move the mobile robot to a specified planar pose, including while carrying an object.
requires: A target pose is specified in the current scene.
A collision-free base route and a safe arm posture are available at execution time.
achieves: The robot reaches the target pose.

outcomes.success: The robot arrives at the requested pose; a carried object remains held.
outcomes.failure: No route or safe arm posture is found, or the carried object is dropped.

verifier.evidence: The function raises SkillFailure when route planning fails and checks a carried object for dropping; final pose needs a separate graph-runner check.

connections.when: Explicit repositioning is useful. Manipulation skills may navigate internally, so this edge is optional.
